summary: Verified CORS/withCredentials bug fix. Backend CORS middleware correctly sets allow_credentials=False when CORS_ORIGINS='*' (wildcard). Frontend config.js no longer sets axios.defaults.withCredentials=true. Curl verified: response has 'access-control-allow-origin: *' but NO 'access-control-allow-credentials' header (invalid combo eliminated). Login as admin@example.com/admin123 works end-to-end on preview URL: dashboard loads with 7 callsigns/10 QSOs, admin panel shows 2 users/18 QSOs, profile button works, logout returns to login screen, language selector (FR/EN) works. No console/page errors.
action_items: User should redeploy Vercel (frontend) and Render (backend) to propagate the fix to production. Ensure Render sets CORS_ORIGINS='https://qso-pocket.vercel.app' (explicit origin) if credentials/cookies are needed later; wildcard is fine for current Bearer-token auth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1208-1218: CORS fix is correct. is_wildcard check prevents the invalid combo 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true'.
config.js: withCredentials removal is correct since auth uses Authorization: Bearer header (JWT), not cookies.
For production on Render, recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit Vercel origin(s) instead of '*' as best practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS bug fixed and verified on preview URL. Fix must be deployed to Render (backend) and Vercel (frontend) by the user via git push. Preview environment behaves correctly.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Browsers reject the CORS response combination 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' + 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' per spec. Old code set allow_credentials=True unconditionally with allow_origins=['*'], and axios sent withCredentials=true, triggering the failure. Fix: server.py computes is_wildcard=('*' in origins) and sets allow_credentials=not is_wildcard; frontend removed axios.defaults.withCredentials=true. Verified via curl OPTIONS preflight — no allow-credentials header returned with wildcard origin.
